image_description: A slender, worm-like snake with a uniform reddish-brown/pinkish-brown coloration coiled on a textured, mossy rock surface. The snake has a glossy appearance with smooth scales and lacks distinct patterning. The head is small and barely distinct from the body.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head visible on the left side of the coil is small, rounded, and transitions smoothly into the body without a distinct neck, matching the description.

The tail end is either tucked under the coil or outside the frame; the visible terminus on the right is ambiguous and likely just a body segment continuing out of view.
